item.title: FDA advisers vote on Grail's multi-cancer blood test
item.description: A key advisory committee to the Food and Drug Administration is meeting today to vote on whether the agency should approve the first multi-cancer blood test, made by Grail. The Galleri test, which costs $949, claims to detect up to 50 forms of cancer, many of which are not routinely screened for…

item.title: Kawhi Leonard signs two-year, $115M extension with Raptors
item.description: Kawhi Leonard has agreed to a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors, according to ESPN.
